theme_archetype.rationale: Pet wellness and care needs to feel warm, approachable, and trustworthy. The off-white base paired with the brand's navy and orange strikes a balance between premium service and friendly pet care.

fonts.heading: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.import_instructions: Import via Google Fonts or Fontshare. Example: @import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400&display=swap'); and @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Mobile-First, Asymmetrical where possible
spacing_and_layout.optical_alignment: Align text left by default, avoid center-everything disease. Provide high padding (p-8 to p-12) inside bordered containers.

surfaces_and_shadows.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#0A4D8C1A] rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(10,77,140,0.03)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#F25C05] text-[#FFFFFF] font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#D95204] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0A4D8C] border-2 border-[#0A4D8C] font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#0A4D8C] hover:text-[#FFFFFF] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

components.badges: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#F5F2EB] text-[#0A4D8C] font-medium text-sm
components.inputs: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#0A4D8C33] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 w-full text-[#05223D] placeholder:text-[#465B70]/60 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F25C05] focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all
components.whatsapp_fab: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(37,211,102,0.3)] hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_12px_48px_rgba(37,211,102,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 z-50 flex items-center justify-center

motion_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_interactions.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and drop shadow deepens. Inner images zoom slightly scale-105 duration-500 ease-out.
motion_interactions.reveal: Use Framer Motion to stagger-fade elements into view on scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a static marketing landing page strictly following the layout sections of smartpaw-draft-4.vercel.app, using pure HTML and Tailwind for layout structures. Do not use generic Shadcn layout wrappers unless highly customized.
Use the exact color codes provided. No purple gradients or standard 'Vercel' looks.
Implement the 'Start your plan' flow as a Lead Capture Form (Name, Email, Phone, Pet Name, Pet Type, Breed/Age). It can be a modal or an inline section.
Add a fixed WhatsApp floating action button on the bottom right linking to +995591969901.
Include a language toggle (EN/KA) in the header (create the UI logic, can just change state/console log for now if no actual translation exists).
Partner logos must be a smooth infinite marquee using 'react-fast-marquee' or CSS animation.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., 'data-testid="start-plan-button"').
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is loaded for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text.
Hero Section: Instead of the video (since it might fail to load), build an overlapping bento-style composition using the hero image provided, layered with text and dual CTAs.
